**Classic Lasagna (about 8–10 servings)** | Category | Typical Ingredients | Notes | |----------|---------------------|-------| | **Lasagna noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) | If using no‑boil, you’ll still need a bit of sauce to keep them from drying out. | | **Meat sauce** | 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | Brown, drain fat, add onions, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, pepper, oregano, basil, a splash of red wine (optional). | | **Ricotta mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese, 1 egg, ½ cup grated Parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, salt, pepper | Whisk until smooth; the egg helps bind. | | **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or a mix of mozzarella & provolone) | Adds gooey melt. | | **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated (for topping) | Adds a sharp finish. | | **Optional extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale (½–1 cup)
• Sliced mushrooms (½ cup)
• Red pepper flakes (pinch)
• Fresh basil or parsley (for garnish) | Feel free to mix in veggies or herbs for extra flavor. | | **Seasonings** | Salt, black pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, garlic powder, onion powder | Adjust to taste. | ### Quick Assembly Steps 1. **Cook noodles** (if not no‑boil) until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of foil or parchment to prevent sticking. 2. **Prepare meat sauce**: sauté onions & garlic → add ground meat → brown → stir in tomatoes, seasonings, and simmer 20–30 min. 3. **Mix ricotta** with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, pepper. 4. **Layer**: start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta, mozzarella, more sauce, repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce and a generous sprinkle of Parmesan. 5. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 35–45 min, covered with foil for the first 25 min, then uncovered to brown the top. 6. **Rest** 10–15 min before slicing to let the layers set. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
